description: Accept, counter or decline an open offer on one of the seller's own listings. Sellers work in PAYOUTS only: a counter is the amount the seller wants to get (counter_payout_usd), and Commonplace sets the buyer price that pays it. Never quote buyer prices to the seller. IMPORTANT consequences: accepting starts the sale and updates the listing to match, and a counter updates the listing for every buyer, not only this one. Requires confirmed: true after the seller agrees.

confirmed.description: false: nothing changes, and the result says what would. true: do it, once the seller has agreed.

counter_payout_usd.description: Required for a counter. What the seller wants to get, in US dollars.
